## Requirements

| requirement | disposition |
|---|---|
| SIG-RQ-007 (owner) | records-requester and document-reviewer tasks show a DRAFT request — statute + citation, template + table versions, agency, deadline, appeal path, residency note — with no requester identity and no transmit path; `status` is always `drafted`, a non-draft row or nonzero `sent` fails the build; `.txt` download per task and per-place bundle. MET |
| SIG-RQ-010 (owner) | bulk queue downloads sharded ≤ 25 MB per file — the per-place draft bundle splits at draft boundaries into `…--part-<n>-of-<m>` (a single draft over the cap fails loud, never a truncated file); hub + place pages link the bundles; a manifest check asserts every emitted file ≤ the cap. MET |
| SIG-UI-039/040 | cited — every new route/file keeps the T1 zero-JS classification (`/task/**`, `/research-queue/**` umbrellas; `.txt` endpoints emit no HTML) |
| SIG-ENG-042 | cited — a task/place with no draft mints no file and renders the named absence; the envelope and every row are validated fail-closed |
| plan cell decisions | `D-K11-3 [B-22] = yes` (drafts published — statutes are public law, templates are SIG's own text, no requester data, never sent), `ADR-171` (a draft is a document the operator may send by hand, never an outbound act) — carried verbatim; no GATE DECISIONS rows added |

## What landed

- `web/src/lib/records-drafts.ts` — the `sig.records-request-drafts/1` model: the `RecordsRequestDraft` row (verbatim `tasks.detect` `as_dict`), the envelope parse + the never-send gate (`assertDraftsNeverSent` + `sent ≠ 0` refuse), `(task_type, subject_id)` matching, the `.txt` builders, and `draftBundleFiles` (per-place bundles sharded ≤ `DRAFT_BUNDLE_MAX_BYTES`).
- `data.ts#getRecordsRequestDrafts` — fixtures → committed corpus through the same gate; export → `web/records_request_drafts.json` (missing artifact = honest absence; malformed or non-draft = build error). `build-fixture-export.ts` emits the envelope.
- Task page: the §5.3 draft block renders the DRAFT (banner, statute/citation, versions, residency note, records sought, verbatim body, `.txt` download, never-send + not-legal-advice lines); badge on queue cards; `sig.task-page/1` twin gains `records_request_draft` + `draft_download`.
- Downloads: `/task/<handle>.draft.txt` per drafted task; `/research-queue/drafts/<place>.txt` (and `…--part-<n>-of-<m>` over the cap) per place facet — hub Downloads and place pages link them (never a dead link).
- Fixture: one `document_reviewer` task in residency-restricted Virginia + the two engine-verbatim draft rows.
- Tests: `records-drafts.test.ts` (13 legs — matching, never-send, txt, ≤25 MB sharding, cap-refusal); `research-queue.spec.ts` +7 legs (render, no-transmit-path, residency, named absence, `.txt`, bundle, badge+twin).
